chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Al-'Is ibn Al-Qasim, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about churches and synagogues: may one perform salat (prayer) in them? He said: "Yes." And I asked him whether it is suitable to demolish them and make them into a masjid. He said: "Yes."

key_terms.الْبِيَعِ: churches or Christian places of worship
key_terms.الْكَنَائِسِ: synagogues or religious worship places referred to in the narration
key_terms.مَسْجِدًا: a masjid, a place designated for Islamic worship

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray in churches and synagogues or convert them into a masjid in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling permitting salat (prayer) in churches and synagogues. It also permits converting such buildings into a masjid, indicating the permissibility of using those places for Islamic worship.
